about: PF HANZO's own config. HANZO is air gapped: its ONLY link to the platform is HTTP to the addresses below, signed with the secret named here. No path, file, database or module of the platform is ever named.

platform.about: where HANZO calls the platform, per side (the platform's global_config offices)

callers.about: the offices that may call HANZO's /api (X-Office), each checked with the secret

secret.name: hanzo_link
secret.purpose: signs every call between the platform and HANZO; each side keeps its own copy in its own instance

developers.about: the developer door (/api/developer/...): a developer signs with their own secret, never HANZO's; an upload is plain files, written into the locker's dev/ folder
